items.distractor_fact: У тій самій квартирі кімнатний термометр показував {D}°C.
items.gloss_en: In that same apartment, the room thermometer showed D°C.
items.entity_note: A different instrument — an indoor room thermometer in a private apartment — unlike the first distractor's different weather station (a place).

items.distractor_fact: Облігації цієї ж компанії того дня продавалися за {D} $.
items.gloss_en: Bonds of that same company were selling for D $ that day.
items.entity_note: A different financial instrument (the company's bonds), unlike the first distractor's different company (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: За нотатками місцевого рибалки, рівень води у сусідньому ставку того самого ранку становив {D} м.
items.gloss_en: According to a local fisherman's notes, the water level in a neighboring pond that same morning was D m.
items.entity_note: A different person's own record (a local fisherman, about a pond), unlike the first distractor's different river (a place).

items.distractor_fact: На сусідньому будівельному майданчику кран піднявся на висоту {D} м.
items.gloss_en: At a neighboring construction site, a crane rose to a height of D m.
items.entity_note: A different place (a construction site) with a different kind of instrument (a crane), unlike the first distractor's different drone (an instrument).

items.distractor_fact: У сусідній транспортній компанії посилка того самого дня важила {D} кг.
items.gloss_en: At a neighboring transport company, a parcel weighed D kg that same day.
items.entity_note: A different organisation (a transport company), unlike the first distractor's different parcel at the same branch (an entity).

items.distractor_fact: GPS-трекер вантажівки тієї самої компанії зафіксував швидкість {D} км/год.
items.gloss_en: The GPS tracker of a truck from that same company recorded a speed of D km/h.
items.entity_note: A different instrument (a GPS tracker on a company truck), unlike the first distractor's different road and radar (a place).

items.distractor_fact: У касі сусіднього відділення банку того ж дня зафіксовано надходження на суму {D} $.
items.gloss_en: At the till of a neighboring bank branch, cash receipts of D $ were recorded that same day.
items.entity_note: A different organisation (a neighboring bank branch's till), unlike the first distractor's different account at this branch (an instrument).

items.distractor_fact: У тому самому торговому центрі за оренду іншого приміщення сплачено {D} $.
items.gloss_en: In that same shopping mall, D $ was paid for the rent of a different unit.
items.entity_note: A different place (the mall itself, via rent for another unit), unlike the first distractor's neighboring shop (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: У таблиці кубкового турніру того самого сезону іншій команді в графі «Закинуто» записано {D}.
items.gloss_en: In the table of that season's cup tournament, another team's "Scored" column shows D.
items.entity_note: A different competition/series (the cup tournament's own table), unlike the first distractor's same league table for a different team (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: На сусідній виробничій лінії того ж цеху за той самий день виготовлено {D} кг продукції.
items.gloss_en: On a neighboring production line of that same workshop, D kg of product was made that same day.
items.entity_note: A different place — a separate production line with its own unstated plan — unlike the first distractor's different workshop (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: Через онлайн-платформу тієї самої мережі за той самий тиждень продано товарів на суму {D} $.
items.gloss_en: Through the online platform of that same retail chain, D $ worth of goods were sold that same week.
items.entity_note: A different sales channel (the chain's online platform, an instrument) with its own unstated plan, unlike the first distractor's different physical shop (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: Домашній дощомір у тому самому місті зафіксував {D} мм опадів.
items.gloss_en: A home rain gauge in that same city recorded D mm of precipitation.
items.entity_note: A different instrument (a private rain gauge with no associated forecast), unlike the first distractor's different district (a place).

items.distractor_fact: У протоколі іншого турніру для іншої лунки в графі «Ударів» записано {D}.
items.gloss_en: In the record of a different tournament, for a different hole, the "Strokes" column shows D.
items.entity_note: A different competition/series (another tournament's scorecard) for a different hole with its own unstated par, unlike the first distractor's different player (a person).

items.distractor_fact: Табло сусідньої платформи того самого ранку показувало час прибуття іншого потяга — {D} хв після півночі.
items.gloss_en: The display board on a neighboring platform that same morning showed another train's arrival time — D min after midnight.
items.entity_note: A different place (a neighboring platform's display board) for a different train with its own unstated schedule, unlike the first distractor's different train route (an organisation/series).

items.distractor_fact: У сусідньому під'їзді того ж будинку поверх, де зупинився ліфт, позначений числом {D}.
items.gloss_en: In a neighboring entrance of that same building, the floor where the elevator stopped is labeled with the number D.
items.entity_note: A different place (a neighboring building entrance) with its own unstated ground-level reference, unlike the first distractor's different elevator (an instrument).

items.distractor_fact: Особистий термометр одного з мешканців того самого дня показував {D}°C.
items.gloss_en: A personal thermometer belonging to one of the residents showed D°C that same day.
items.entity_note: A different instrument (a resident's personal thermometer), unlike the first distractor's third city (a place).
